# AISTATS 2027 template

Unmodified files from the [official paper
pack](https://aistats.org/aistats2027/AISTATS2027PaperPack.zip), downloaded on
September 16, 2026. The [call for
papers](https://virtual.aistats.org/Conferences/2027/CallForPapers) links this
archive. Retain the upstream notices in the files. The conference manuscript
loads both `aistats2027.sty` and the bundled `fancyhdr.sty` from this directory.
`sample_paper.tex` records the original formatting and checklist instructions.

SHA-256 checksums:

```text
aac31ecf2e41f5a2b7f21d00094bfc2fc1207c34d9f955e991b66f3dc98fdb9b  AISTATS2027PaperPack.zip
33ab38f8aac4b2f1df9fe67e354928598200584e9568385f32deb889e1b81d42  aistats2027.sty
b56ec4434b9f4607529a4b23dc68ad8d4b94f1f631c8cddaf7da78140d53a5ea  fancyhdr.sty
b7e89d57b6d18d01eaeb6d3bf219d87b7763ce6268a07a7c6916df2de1e5370d  sample_paper.tex
```

The default style is anonymous and displays the conference's standard review
footer. Using that footer in a local draft does not mean a submission has been
made. Do not alter the style to fit extra content.
